meta.name: dart-setup-ffi-assets
meta.description: Guides agents in compiling and packaging C/C++ source code into dynamic or static libraries (Code Assets) using Dart's Native Assets hook system (via hook/build.dart and hook/link.dart utilizing package:hooks and package:native_toolchain_c). Use when a user asks to: 'setup native assets', 'compile C/C++ source code', 'bundle dynamic libraries', 'build native C code', 'link native assets', 'implement build.dart or link.dart hooks', or 'integrate C/C++ interop in Dart/Flutter'. Helps agents avoid manual toolchain orchestration and configures secure hash-validated binary downloads or advanced linker tree-shaking with package:record_use mapping.
